course.title: Digital Logic Design
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: A sequential circuit has two flip-flops (A and B), two inputs (x and y) and an. output (z). The (15) flip-flop input functions and the circuit output functions are as follows:

$$
z = x y A + x ^ { \prime } y ^ { \prime } B
$$
(i) Draw the logic diagram, (ii) Draw the state table, (iii) Draw the state diagram, and (iv) Find the state equation.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
